valid.name: a purely callable union is not a mix
undefined is neutral, so an optional callable stays a single shape
a purely data union is not a mix
a method-bearing library interface counts as neither callable nor data evidence, so the pervasive Promise<T> | T return idiom is not a mix

valid.code: type MaybeMapEntryType<K, V> = Map<K, V> | V;
valid.name: a second method-bearing library interface union member is not callable evidence either
Function intersected with only its own intrinsic prototype member is not a mix - the polymorphic static-factory idiom lexical-this-only also permits

valid.code: type NamedConstructorType<TInstance> = Function & { readonly 'name': string; readonly 'prototype': TInstance };
valid.name: Function intersected with more than one intrinsic function member (name and prototype) is still not a mix

invalid.code:
type CallbackType = () => void;
type IndirectMixedType = CallbackType | { a: 1 };
invalid.name: named callable reference mixed with data
callable interface reference mixed with data
mixed nested inside a property
the global Function type mixed with data is callable evidence, not an exempt lib-interface fallback
any admits a callable value, so any mixed with data is still a mix
a call signature in the second block of a declaration-merged interface is still callable evidence

invalid.code:
type Wrap<T> = T;
type ViaWrapType = Wrap<() => void> | { a: 1 };
invalid.name: a generic identity alias substitutes the caller's concrete type argument instead of recursing into its bare type parameter

invalid.code: type MixedFactoryType<TInstance> = Function & { readonly 'prototype': TInstance; retries: number };
invalid.name: Function intersected with an intrinsic member PLUS a genuine data member (retries) is still a mix - the exemption does not cover added members outside the intrinsic allowlist
